train_BC_policy: train a behavior cloning policy on expert trajectories using MSE or MLE loss
fit_BC_with_data: fit a BC model on observation and expert action data with mini-batch SGD
compute_BC_transformations: compute input and output mean and std transformations from expert path data
review_BC_mle_loss: review the BC class mle_loss method that minimizes negative log likelihood
refactor_BC_set_transformations: refactor the BC set_transformations method to apply scaling to policy models
